$comment: Core v2's per-ticket mutation runs (ticket M1-62, core-v2-m1-tickets.md § 2 and § 4; file map core-v2-m1-file-owners.md § 8). Read by script-py/mutation_v2.py and .github/workflows/mutation-v2.yml; checked by test/box-v2/m1-62/. tickets: the parts M1-62's entry names, each with its money-path sources under src/box-v2/ (owner as in the file map; extra = a source the goal does not name, with why) and its test folders. A file with newFile is its owner's new file that no file-map row names (open point 1), with where the owner says so. moneyPaths: M1-62's goal, item by item, with the sources that carry it. notInRun: every other v2 source outside interfaces/ and stubs/, with why (the runner warns about a source in neither list, and test_mutation_v2_round1.py fails). equivalents: survivors argued equivalent, one by one, each with its reason and the evidence file that argues it (the ticket's review lens); each row argues one mutant (the mutants forge skips behind a survivor are run by the runner itself, from forge's results file; span 'all' is retired); occurrence names which line where the text repeats in the file; sha256 pins the file (rows on frozen files must, or the manifest is refused). forge: the Foundry version the runner requires (forge --version), the workflow's too. Each ticket lists its rows in its evidence and the integrator writes them here at merge (file map rule 5). excludeTests: fork tests never run in a mutation run (no network). artifacts: built before a run (forge build; the M1-03 kit loads the PoolManager by artifact). sharedPaths: a change there starts every ticket's run (--changed-since).

equivalents.reason: PLATFORM_SHARE is HeldKind's last member and Solidity 0.8 refuses an enum value past the last (a conversion panics with 0x21, the ABI decoder reverts), so >= and == agree on every value a HeldKind holds; it stops being equivalent if a member is appended after PLATFORM_SHARE
